headline: See the combo.
*Throw* it.
shots.sub: Every 3 seconds the next punch flashes up in big letters, until the round ends.

headline: One challenge
*every* day
shots.sub: Rounds, rest and punches set for your level. Prop the phone up and press start.

headline: Challenge *done*.
Streak: 7 days.
shots.sub: +39 XP, saved when the last round ends. Train tomorrow to make it 8.

headline: Every round
earns *XP*
shots.sub: 10 XP a round plus 1 a minute. Watch your level and your week fill up.

headline: Ask a question,
get a *drill*
shots.sub: Say what keeps going wrong. The answer comes with a round to run.

headline: The drill loads
on the *timer*
shots.sub: One tap on the answer: its punches, rounds and rest, ready to start.

headline: Scout a partner,
drill the *plan*
shots.sub: One photo in, a 3-round plan out.
